name: facebookresearch_all-atom-diffusion-transformer/src/tools/ase_notebook/backend/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_all-atom-diffusion-tran.create_atom_images: create AtomImages from a list of ase.Atoms with custom element radii and radii scale
facebookresearch_all-atom-diffusion-tran.create_atom_gui: create an AtomGui instance with a ViewConfig, atom images, and custom element colors
facebookresearch_all-atom-diffusion-tran.draw_elements: draw atoms, bonds, cell lines, and miller planes on a tkinter canvas from element groups
facebookresearch_all-atom-diffusion-tran.draw_circle: draw a colored circle on a tkinter canvas with optional selection outline and stroke width

facebookresearch_all-atom-diffusion-tran.svg_to_pdf: convert an SVG object or string to a PDF drawing using reportlab and svglib
facebookresearch_all-atom-diffusion-tran.svg_to_pil: convert an SVG object or string to a PIL Image using cairosvg

facebookresearch_all-atom-diffusion-tran.generate_3js_render: create a pythreejs 3D scene rendering atoms, bonds, cell lines, and miller planes from element groups
facebookresearch_all-atom-diffusion-tran.add_labels: create label sprite elements with text textures for atoms in a pythreejs scene
facebookresearch_all-atom-diffusion-tran.create_world_axes: create a synced axes renderer showing world orientation aligned to the main camera
facebookresearch_all-atom-diffusion-tran.make_basic_gui: build an interactive ipywidgets GUI layout with toggle controls for atoms, bonds, labels, and background
facebookresearch_all-atom-diffusion-tran.RenderContainer: create a frozen attribute container for pythreejs renderer elements with ipython display support
